after it. Those two facts produce most of the list mistakes on the exam, and
neither survives being told once. So the list is drawn with its index under
every element and it renumbers in front of you.
An operation with an out of range index is REFUSED rather than silently
ignored, and refusing costs no moves: the message is the lesson, and
charging for it would only teach students not to try. Case 5 is built so
